payload.body: Your A8 plan is right, the two defaults included. The dispatch table is the one home of st edit's vocabulary and its declared default, so dispatch::arg_default beside arg_values is the right door, and INFO_STEM is not wanted at those two sites. `all` stays a literal. No CHANGELOG line. Base: main at 68583ddff, where cc's v1 landed (8275652e3, 203bcf4b7 and 5f8d5cefa; its CHANGELOG at 68583ddff). Bank at refs/bank/ic/st1c2db93/stems/v1 and report as before.
